title: ScenarioManifest
description: Regenerated from xtask_lab::scenario::ScenarioManifest (xtask-lab/src/scenario.rs). Human-authored input to `cargo lab run`: describes a cluster situation and who a correct diagnosis should name. Materialized into a synthetic Episode (datasets/schema/episode.schema.json) which `cargo lab score` then grades a heuristic replay against.

name.description: The situation, in the words a user would use -- becomes Episode.scenario.

victim_stall_us.description: The victim's total PSI stall for this scenario's window, in microseconds.

consumers.description: CPU consumers during the stall window. A pod may appear more than once (one entry per process); its shares are summed.

forks.description: Fork counts observed in the window, keyed by pod.

short_jobs.description: Short-lived-job counts observed in the window, keyed by pod.

expect_reported.description: Offenders a correct diagnosis should name, in rank order. The first entry becomes the materialized episode's ground_truth; later entries document a scenario with more than one real offender but are not separately scored by `xtask lab score`, which only grades the top-ranked prediction. Empty when no offender should clear the reporting bar.
